Data.Responsibility:
What the Role Entails
Take active part in the training, learning, culture and employee engagement projects. Actively act as team member to contribute innovative ideas, and take on project management roles, when at the same time can be hands-on with project operation documents, including graphic, document design and drafting.
Support in sourcing internal and external partnership, vendor and speakers to ensure high quality, value adding content of different layers are provided in the program design.
Support HRBP leader in day to day HRBP responsibilities, providing BP support to business teams world-wide, and ensuring alignment with global HR strategies.
Being a trusted advisor to provide insights on business decisions from a human capital perspective which includes but not limited to talent management, performance management, workforce strategy, employee engagement & retention.
Collaborate closely with the business leaders on people matters which may have short-, medium- or long-term effects on the business
Build strong partnerships with HR teams with both local and global investment companies and develop deep understanding of organizational dynamics in each entity
Identify opportunities for resource sharing and ensuring compliance in workforce decisions
Driving and helping to connect the dots between global/local decisions in contrast with HQ decisions, to mediate and align expectations across all parties
Support cross-functional HR projects  as needed, and collaborate well with key HR stakeholders, including HRBP and HR function teams to ensure project success
Challenges
Ability to operate in ambiguous and grey-zone scopes — defining and creating value where frameworks don’t yet exist.
Requires self-direction and initiative to build new relationships, identify gaps, and drive change.
Must be comfortable navigating cross-cultural stakeholder management and regional diversity.

Who We Look For
Above 5 years of experience as a HR Business Partner, demonstrating strong stakeholder management skills and business acumen
Possess exposure across the gaming industry, ideally with experience supporting overseas businesses in their expansion
Possess experience dealing with Performance Management, Rewards, Talent retention, Talent Management and Employee Relations
Good experience in training, and employee engagement, creative and hands-on; strong capability in bi-lingual documentations, and communication graphic, video design is a plus
Someone who is positive, possess a can-do attitude and can navigate in highly matrixed and ambiguous environments
Strong people skillsets and able to build relationships across all levels of staff, be culturally sensitive and adaptable to different people styles; a good team player, has strong sense of teamwork and are willing to work with others
Strong learning agility, with good ability to bounce back and quickly learn from past experiences, improve, and adapt
Bilingual abilities (English/Chinese) will be considered a competitive edge as it will be required to deal with employees locally

Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: China-Shenzhen
